notes.title: #2 Update and Progress
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback!
After thorough analysis and consideration, our development team has identified that most current issues stem from limitations in the legacy UI framework.

To address this, we are fully committed to rebuilding a brand-new UI framework, focusing on the following improvements:

Comprehensive upgrades to mouse/keyboard/controller compatibility

Optimized UI interaction logic for smoother operation

Enhanced gameplay experience, including adjusted pacing for early/mid-game progression and refined difficulty curve

As this update involves a complete low-level framework, we require additional time for development and stability testing. I sincerely apologize for the delayed release .

Our team remains dedicated to delivering the best possible experience. 
Thank you for your understanding and patience!

With gratitude,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/6aca37fb00e22c379c7f5df07bff4c9c88d27843.png

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update Preview | Free Game + Free DLC | Community Appreciation
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continuous play and support. Your encouragement and positive review are the greatest motivation for us to keep improving and pushing forward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/bf634da780ae90a8844e3537aa2f9cbe10dd1cb5.gif
Free DLC
We will soon be releasing the 1.1.0 update, which will be divided into two phases:


 New Characters (2 characters) and new Spells（These days）
 New Weapon Kit: Dagger（These days）
 High-difficulty Levels (scheduled for public release in mid-December)


Free Game
Our team has recently released Arisen Force: Life Devotee, a free Souls-like ARPG with high difficulty. The game simplifies some aspects of equipment progression and focuses more on enemy and combat design, making the battles more interactive and challenging. Multi-language support is currently being translated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/058ea2c9fe7da13876be7167c2b45964a460b193.jpg

Soundtrack
We have released the game’s official soundtrack. After downloading, the MP3 format is available for playback on Steam, while the WAV format can be found in the parent folder at the same path.

Technical Aspects
Since the game's release, our team has been working hard to maintain and update the game, gradually improving its stability and adding many new features, such as remappable keys and a trainning mode. We are also aware of certain UI interaction issues that persist on specific devices. This is due to our limited hardware, which prevents us from replicating and pinpointing the exact cause of these issues. As a result, our tech team has decided to completely rebuild the UI’s underlying logic in a more universal way to better support a wider range of devices and players.

Community Appreciation
We still remember the initial reports from some players regarding a bug where their characters had abnormally high stats. Through email correspondence, beta testing, and save file submissions, we were able to locate the issue: certain devices (possibly related to memory) were parsing our game’s floating-point values as integers, leading to unintended stat boosts. We have now resolved this issue.

When bugs are related to hardware, fixing and addressing them becomes more difficult. If you encounter any unexpected issues, please feel free to send us feedback via email. If possible, please include screenshots and compressed save files, as they are crucial for fixing and identifying the problem.

Save file path: C:\Users\{Username}\AppData\LocalLow\ArisenForce\HeroTest

Special Thanks
Finally, we'd like to thank all players once again. Your positive reviews are the greatest support for our development team and the warmest encouragement for us to continue working on new updates.

Thank you,
The Arisen Force Team

notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for playing Arisen Force: HeroTest during the Steam Next Fest and for providing us with such valuable feedback!

We've noticed that :

Sometimes players experienced issues when trying to pick up healing items, but trigger an unexpectedly jump, leading to unfortunate defeats in battle. 
Manually picking up dropped items one by one felt inefficient.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/583469187876ee2139169266776f5130b1624a85.gif
This design wasn't our original direction, 
hence we’ve updated the item pickup system to trigger automatically, allowing you to stay focused on the action without being interrupted by accidental jumps or tedious item collection.

Welcome to have a new experience on our Demo of HeroTest.

Looking ahead, we plan to further improve the visuals and sound effects for item pickups to enhance your experience.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Welcome to the Time Temple, Traveler, Let us introduce exciting combat tips
notes.content:
Dear Players,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/573d58c31d5ae7034d159fa85ff203c53c9b1209.jpg
Hello, everyone. We are Lemport team from ArisenForceTeam.

We are delighted and grateful that you are trying out our demo. In the future, we will continue to improve the guidance in the demo so that more players can get started and experience our rich combat mechanics.
Players have many choices in combat. Whether you prefer to go solo or team up, focus on action or strategy, attracting enemy aggro and have your backline deal damage. All approaches are viable.

Let's share some simple tips to make your battles more exciting and enjoyable.

Charging Attack(CA)
Firstly, let's talk about charge attacks. Holding down the attack button will trigger different moves depending on the weapon equipped. Our charge attacks are executed uniquely based on the equipment in the player's hand. While normal weapons have a general charge move, special weapons will have different charge attacks even if they are of the same type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/3137df0b182656210f8ec94006d681b460b28575.gif
For example, the Gun charged attack can load one grenade bullet, but if a perfect reload is triggered through the JUST mechanism, it can load three grenades.

JUST System
When players perform precise actions at the right moment, they can trigger the JUST system to receive positive rewards.

JUST Evade
When the player performs a dodge at the moment of being attacked, the JUST Dodge mechanism is triggered, resulting in different counterattack actions depending on the weapon type.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/891dc0a41c80dc71bc22b0734c52965baffd5395.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/fd09b7f8f8088460b5444047088087eac2b7bc3b.gif

JUST CAST
Even some CA attack could contain JUST System.
For Example the Sword CA could get through the arrow when cast at a perfect timing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/5fdc0035ba57e96966b2241f28c0b418ac6ef7e4.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/d23eecd7ceb566745b0d95f0c8061bdb8b4e2900.gif

Of course, we have many more positive and precise reward opportunities waiting for you to discover.

UNIQUE TALENT

Our uniquely designed talent system is the result of our bold research and development efforts. This system significantly enhances and highlights the distinctiveness and fun of each character, while the combination of skills and weapons further deepens the game's mechanics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/0ac074f2b8b7aa59eb0660babf4eb672b43cb4ec.png
*Please refer to the official talent design for details.

EXECUTE
When an enemy's accumulated damage reaches a certain threshold, they will enter a weakened state, indicated by a flashing gold light. At this point, the player can approach and press F (keyboard) or the East button (controller) to execute a special finishing attack on the enemy.The execution will immediately knock down the enemy and interrupt their current action.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/cb049ad265b49813a9385f23bc642dbe3f10af22.gif

TEAM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036987/3d42e81e978e226c386fc3c6296c65017413caf2.gif
The team system has been streamlined to focus on enhancing combat. When players successfully complete a hero's challenge, that hero automatically joins the team. By interacting with the goddess, players can invite these heroes to join the active combat team.
*In the DEMO, you can converse with the goddess to bring up rescued teammates, but for adventuring together, please look forward to the official version content.

Summary

"Arisen Force: HeroTest" is more than just a game—it's a symbol of our evolution, our aspirations, and our unwavering commitment to excellence. It represents the collective effort of a team that refuses to settle for mediocrity and a community that inspires us to reach new heights.

We wish to express our heartfelt thanks for being a part of this extraordinary journey. Together, we are creating something truly special, and we can't wait to share the next chapter with you.

Feel free to share the game's Steam link with everyone!
Thank you and welcome to everyone who added us to your wishlist!

Warm regard,
ArisenForceTeam-Lemport
